If no changes you're making are having any effect, one of three things is going on:
You're editing a plugin file, but the project is using a different copy of it.
You haven't reloaded the game since changing the plugin (that seems unlikely)
Some other plugin is also overriding the same function, and it's ignoring the changes you're making in this plugin.
Add the function to its own file instead of overwriting it in the yanfly plugin, then save it as a .js file, and import it into your plugin manager below all of the other plugins you have, which will ensure that it's not being overwritten by anything else.
